papers.title: Coating composition for a urinary catheter (US8133580B2)
papers.purpose: 完整雙層 UV 塗層配方基準，Harland FTS 測試規格
papers.abstract_note: 本發明揭示一種醫療導管之雙層親水潤滑塗層系統。內層（底塗）含有聚醚型高分子與 Norrish I 型光起始劑（Irgacure 2959），藉由 UV 固化形成穩定錨固層；外層（頂塗）由聚乙烯吡咯烷酮（PVP）與聚電解質組成，提供優異的水濕潤滑性。雙層結構設計使頂塗能滲入底塗形成機械互鎖，顯著提升塗層附著力與耐磨耗性。本配方為 DSM ComfortCoat 核心技術，廣泛應用於心血管及泌尿科導管產品。
papers.value_to_project: 最完整的雙層 UV 配方+測試規格基準

full.summary: US8133580B2 is a DSM urinary catheter coating patent built around a two-layer UV cured system: a PTGL1000-(T-H)2 / PVP / Irgacure primer and an outer PVP / polyelectrolyte / benzophenone / glycerol functional layer. The full text has one named working example, but it contains two primer solutions and two functional coating solutions, so the useful reading is as formulation variants rather than a single recipe. The coated 14 Fr PVC catheter is dip coated on a Harland PCX coater, cured at 0.9 J/cm2 for primer and 21.6 J/cm2 for topcoat, then stored at 100% humidity and gamma sterilized.

full.summary: US4769013A is a strong Hydromer medical-device node. It discloses polyurethane complexed with PVP, then complexed with a bio-effecting agent such as an antibacterial or antifungal agent. The text explicitly mentions coatings for medical devices including catheters and wound drainage tubes, and slow release in water or body fluids. This makes it an early Hydromer bridge from lubricious/hydrophilic materials to active, bio-effecting coatings.
key_findings: Hydromer-owned and expired.
PVP is complexed with polyurethane and then with a bio-effecting agent.
Bio-effecting agents include antibacterial and antifungal agents; iodine is a key example.
Use includes medical-device coatings such as catheters and wound drainage tubes.
Mechanism is slow release in water/body fluids from PVP-containing material.

full.summary: US7008979B2 is a Hydromer broad aqueous hydrophilic coating platform. The full text contains 52 examples across polycarbonate, films, anti-fog, inkjet, controlled release, catheter and antimicrobial variants. The medical-device signal is an aqueous PVP + polyurethane dispersion + colloidal silica + aziridine crosslinker system, with catheter embodiments showing very low wet friction and a silver antimicrobial variant that does not compromise adhesion/lubricity.

papers.title: Hydrophilic coating comprising a polyelectrolyte (EP1957130B1)
papers.purpose: polyelectrolyte 對 dry-out time 與吸水速率的貢獻
papers.abstract_note: 本發明涉及在親水潤滑塗層配方中加入聚電解質（ionomer）成分，以提升塗層的抗乾燥性能（dry-out resistance）與吸水速率。聚電解質的引入使塗層在低濕度環境下仍能維持足夠的水合程度，延緩塗層失效。同時，改良配方顯著加快導管插入前的塗層活化速度，縮短術前準備時間。該技術為 DSM 第二代 UV 固化親水塗層系統，為 P01 之延伸改良。
papers.value_to_project: polyelectrolyte 延長保濕時間的配方機制

full.summary: DSM / Astra Tech 的 EP1957130B1 是 ComfortCoat 路線中很重要的抗乾燥親水塗層專利。全文實施例顯示，其核心不是單純加入 PVP，而是在 PEG4000DA/PEO 或 PVP 面塗中加入 poly(acrylamide-co-acrylic acid) partial sodium salt（PAcA）作為 polyelectrolyte，藉由離子水合提升離水後的 dry-out lubricity。Examples 1-3 與 Comparative A-B 直接比較有無 polyelectrolyte 的摩擦維持時間；Example 4 則展示 PVP/PAcA/benzophenone/glycerol 配方經 gamma sterilisation 後仍維持潤滑、乾燥時間與附著，對導尿管抗乾燥設計很有參考價值。

key_claims: 親水塗層包含親水聚合物與 polyelectrolyte，以提升 dry-out lubrication。
PAcA 類 poly(acrylamide-co-acrylic acid) partial sodium salt 是全文實施例的核心聚電解質。
PVP/benzophenone Norrish II 路線與 PEG4000DA/PEO/Irgacure Norrish I 路線都可搭配 polyelectrolyte。
與 P01 的 polyether/PVP primer 搭配形成 DSM 雙層 UV 固化親水塗層系統。
actionable_insights: Dry-out time 的真正可操作變因是 PAcA / polyelectrolyte 的離子水合，而不是單純提高 PVP 或 PEO 比例。
Example 3 的 PVP 5% + PAcA 1.25% + BP 0.1% 是最值得作為 PVP 系統抗乾燥正對照的配方。
Example 4 顯示 glycerol + PAcA 可改善 gamma sterilisation 後的 dry-out / cracking / adhesion，適合往產品化驗證延伸。
Comparative A/B 可作為內部實驗的陰性對照，量化 polyelectrolyte 的增益。
red_flags: PAcA / polyelectrolyte 是 claim 風險核心，若直接使用 acrylic acid/acrylamide 鹽類共聚物需做 FTO。
與 P01 primer 族群共同構成 DSM ComfortCoat 壁壘，不能只看面塗。
Comparative data 顯示無 polyelectrolyte 的 dry-out 表現很差；若設計迴避，需用其他保水機制補足。
到期日、各國法律狀態與 EP/US family claim 範圍仍需逐案核對。
full.vs_database: P02與P01是同一DSM家族，P01保護底塗+雙層結構，P02保護面塗配方（PVP+polyelectrolyte）。P03(WO2009112548A1)是更早期的國際公開版本。三者構成DSM專利壁壘
full.bioteque_relevance: 抗乾燥性是間歇導尿管的重要功能需求。建議以 PEO 或 PVA 取代聚電解質作為抗乾燥設計，迴避 P02 的聚電解質 claim。
full.examples_note: 已依 Google Patents EP1957130B1 全文補入 Examples 1-4 與 Comparative A-B；前台應顯示 6 個實驗單元，其中 4 個正式實施例、2 個對照實驗。
key_findings: Examples 1-3 直接證明加入 PAcA / polyelectrolyte 可顯著降低 dry-out 後摩擦。
Example 3（PVP + PAcA + benzophenone）15 分鐘仍維持約 18.1 g 摩擦，遠優於 Comparative B 10 分鐘約 193 g。
Example 1（PEG4000DA + PEO + PAcA + Tween 80）15 分鐘約 20.8 g，優於無 PAcA 的 Comparative A 15 分鐘約 238.7 g。
Example 4 加入 glycerol，並提到 gamma sterilisation 後仍潤滑、乾燥時間佳、附著足夠且無可見裂紋。
此專利將抗乾燥性能從概念推進到可量化配方與摩擦表，是 DSM ComfortCoat 演進中的關鍵節點。

先上 primer，再上 hydrophilic topcoat

claim_focus: 親水聚合物 + polyelectrolyte 的抗乾燥潤滑塗層。
PVP/BP 或 PEGDA/PEO/Irgacure 系統中加入 PAcA 類聚電解質。
Polyelectrolyte 對 dry-out lubricity / water retention 的功能性保護。
與 DSM primer 技術組合形成雙層塗層平台。
design_around_notes: 若要避開，優先考慮非離子保水系統（PEG/PEO/glycerol/sorbitol 類）或 zwitterionic anti-fouling，而非 acrylic acid/acrylamide 鹽類 polyelectrolyte。

若必須使用 PAcA 類材料，需查 family claims 與到期狀態，不宜只看單一 EP B1。

papers.title: Hydrophilic coating (WO2009112548A1)
papers.purpose: Pebax 導管雙光起始劑配方 (Norrish I+II)
papers.abstract_note: 本發明描述一種以 Harland 175-24 PCX 塗覆設備施用於 Pebax 7233 導管基材之親水塗層製程。配方結合 Norrish I 型（Irgacure 2959）與 Norrish II 型（benzophenone）雙光起始劑系統，前者引發自由基聚合交聯，後者促進表面接枝。固化後塗層展現低摩擦係數、高透明度及優異的體內留置穩定性。本專利為 DSM ComfortCoat 商業化核心專利之一，涵蓋多種聚合物基材的適用範圍。
papers.value_to_project: Pebax 基材雙光起始劑系統配方

full.summary: WO2009112548A1 is DSM hydrophilic coating work focused on low particulate release from a UV cured Pebax catheter shaft coating. The key formulation combines PEG1500 diacrylamide, PVP, PAcA, benzophenone, Irgacure 2959 and Tween 80 over a PTGL1000(T-H)2 primer. Comparative experiments remove the Norrish Type II photoinitiator or use PEGDA instead of the claimed multifunctional polymerizable compound, showing the invention reduces particulate release under a wear test.

full.summary: US9138510 is a Coloplast/Astra-style ready-to-use hydrophilic catheter patent. The key invention is not only the catheter coating, but sterilizing/storing the wetted hydrophilic catheter in an aqueous liquid containing dissolved hydrophilic polymer such as PVP K-25. Full text includes catheter coating Examples 1-4 and water-retention/friction Examples 5-6, showing that irradiation in saline alone hurts retention/friction, while saline plus 6% PVP maintains performance.

formulation.topcoat: PVP 5 parts + urea 1 part + ethanol/gamma-butyrolactone 94 parts; second dip topcoat.

examples.process: Dip first layer, dry 1 min ambient; dip topcoat, dry 30 min at 70 C; UV 200-300 nm for 5 min; sterilize while wetted with PVP solution.
examples.results: Lubricious hydrophilic catheter; used as reference coating in water-retention tests.

examples.results: Modified ASTM D1894 friction force 0.02 N in water.

full.summary: WO1998058990A1 is an early Astra/Medicon-style UV crosslinked PVP hydrophilic coating patent. It discloses seven working examples using PVP K90 in ethanol/gamma-butyrolactone, UV exposure at 200-300 nm, and single- or two-layer coatings on PVC catheters or polyurethane tubes. The important design evolution is from single crosslinked PVP layer to two-layer coatings, then to urea or hydroxypropylcellulose additives and differential crosslinking to balance abrasion resistance and low friction.

full.summary: US20150038947A1 / US9931442B2 is an Astra Tech hydrophilic catheter patent focused on substrate surface roughness/texture rather than a new coating chemistry. Full text compares rough versus smooth versions of Pebax, PVC and Meliflex substrates coated with the same Desmodur IL/PVP isocyanate coating, and a UV-PVP PVC pair. Increased Ra/Rdc improves water retention after wetting.

full.summary: US20110144579A1 is a lubricious two-layer thermoset coating patent for balloon catheters and similar devices. The platform is a polyurethane or polyurea primer carrying PEO, followed by a polyurethane/polyurea PVP topcoat. Full text provides several formulation variants under Example 1 and comparative examples showing that omitting the PEO primer causes poor durability after rubbing.

full.summary: US8378011B2 is a Boston Scientific/Scimed hydrophilic coating durability patent. It uses acrylic monomer crosslinking to form an IPN/SIPN network that holds PEO or other hydrophilic polymer on guidewire/catheter surfaces. The formula can include silane, flow modifier, photoinitiator, aziridine and binder. It should be linked after P24/US6610035B2: P24 solves hydrogel premature moisture uptake, blocking and packaging/delamination problems, while P35 moves toward abrasion resistance, adhesion and durable guidewire/catheter coating.

full.summary: WO2007089761A2 is an InterV/Merit lubricious echogenic coating application. The invention combines primer/tie layers, echogenic microparticles such as EXPANCEL gas/liquid-containing particles, and optional hydrophilic/lubricious topcoats on needles, wires, guidewires and related devices. Full text contains many examples; this record captures the clinically relevant architecture variants rather than every repetitive substrate example.

examples.name: Example 2 - stainless steel wire primer / tie / echogenic layer
examples.credibility_reason: Explicit wire coating example in full text.

formulation.primer: Coating Solution A; dried 10-15 min at 75 C to improve adhesion.
formulation.topcoat: Coating Solution B tie layer, then Coating Solution C echogenic layer with microparticles.

examples.process: Coat A, dry; coat B, dry 12-15 min at 75 C; coat C, incubate 70% RH at 40 C for 60 min; cure 75 C at least 15 min.
examples.results: Forms echogenic coating on wire; adhesion/tie-layer architecture.

examples.name: Example 3 - venous access needle echogenic coating
examples.credibility_reason: Explicit needle example.
examples.substrate: Venous access needle / V-stick by InterV.

formulation.primer: Coating Solution A.
formulation.topcoat: Solution B tie layer + Solution C echogenic layer.

examples.process: Same A/B/C coating, humidity incubation and 75 C cure.
examples.results: Forms echogenic coating on needle.

examples.name: Example 4 - needle tip silicone spray to reduce penetration force
examples.credibility_reason: Explicit silicone tip modification.
examples.substrate: Venous access needle with echogenic coating.

formulation.primer: A/B/C echogenic coating as previous example.
formulation.topcoat: Aminofunctional dimethylsiloxane copolymer MDX4-4159 sprayed at needle tip.

examples.process: After echogenic coating, spray only needle tip with MDX4-4159.
examples.results: Reduced needle penetration force without deleterious effect on echogenicity.

examples.name: Example 19 - EXPANCEL microparticles in first/intermediate layer
examples.credibility_reason: Explicit Example 19.

formulation.primer: Coating Solution A doped with 0.5-5 wt% EXPANCEL microparticles; dried 15 min at 75 C.
formulation.topcoat: Coating Solution B over layer, dried at least 15 min at 75 C.

examples.process: Layered coating with polymeric gas/liquid microparticles.
examples.results: Smooth echogenic coating adhered well, resisted wet/dry abrasion, and was lubricious when wet; expected ultrasound visibility for weeks/months.

examples.name: Example 20 - EXPANCEL microparticles in tie layer
examples.credibility_reason: Explicit Example 20.

formulation.primer: Coating Solution A primer.
formulation.topcoat: Coating Solution B doped with 0.5-10 wt% EXPANCEL microparticles.

examples.process: Primer dry 15 min at 75 C; doped tie layer dry at least 15 min at 75 C.
examples.results: Smooth echogenic coating adhered well and resisted abrasion under wet/dry conditions.

examples.name: Hydrophilic topcoat variant - echogenic layer plus hydrophilic Solution F
examples.credibility_reason: Disclosed in full text near examples 20-21 as topcoat placement variant.

formulation.primer: Coating Solution A + Coating Solution B intermediate layer.
formulation.topcoat: Hydrophilic Coating Solution F doped with 0.5-10 wt% EXPANCEL microparticles.

examples.process: Dip hydrophilic solution F; dry at least 30 min at 75 C.
examples.results: Smooth echogenic and lubricious coating; adhered well and resisted abrasion.

full.mechanism: 親水層降低插入摩擦；微氣泡/微粒強散射超音波；兩功能分層不互相干擾
key_findings: Echogenicity is provided by gas/liquid-containing microparticles, often EXPANCEL.
Lubricity can be added as a hydrophilic topcoat or combined layer.
Layer location of microparticles can vary: primer/intermediate/topcoat.
Medical targets include needles, guidewires, dilators and catheters.
actionable_insights: For product mapping, P25/P32 should be linked as Merit/InterV echogenic-lubricious coating branch.
Do not overfocus on catheter coating; many embodiments are metal needles/wires.
If adding ultrasound visibility to lubricious devices, microparticle layer placement is the key variable.
red_flags: Examples are repetitive and device-specific; exact Coating Solution formulas should be extracted from PDF tables before lab replication.
Echogenic microparticles may conflict with smoothness/particulate requirements for vascular devices.

papers.abstract_note: 本發明涉及一種含有 4-甲基丙烯氧基-2-羥基二苯甲酮（MHB）之光活性親水共聚物塗層。MHB 與甲基丙烯醯胺（HEAA）及丙烯酸（AA）共聚，賦予高分子鏈光反應性，可在 UV 照射下直接共價接枝至導管基材表面。固化後塗層潤滑性達 25 gf 以下（Harland FTS 測試），耐磨耗性優異，乾燥後可迅速再活化。本配方整合底塗與頂塗功能於單一聚合物，簡化塗覆製程。

full.summary: US12037560B2 is a Biocoat/Integer UV-cure topcoat patent for medical devices. papers.title: Hydrophilic coating (US8871869 / 含界面活性劑)
papers.purpose: 含surfactant的親水塗層配方+測試
papers.abstract_note: 本發明揭示一種含界面活性劑（surfactant）之 UV 固化親水塗層配方。界面活性劑的加入降低塗層表面張力，顯著提升初始潤滑性能。以 Harland FTS 系統測試，第一循環潤滑力 ≤ 20 g，達到業界頂級水準。配方配合含聚電解質的潤濕液（wetting fluid）使用，可進一步延長塗層有效潤滑時間。塗層對多種醫用聚合物基材具有良好附著性，適用於心血管導管及輸尿管支架等留置器械。
papers.value_to_project: surfactant配方+Harland FTS驗收標準

full.summary: Surmodics 含界面活性劑（surfactant）UV 固化塗層（US8871869），界面活性劑降低塗液表面張力，顯著提升初始潤滑速率（< 20g，Harland FTS 第一循環）。配合含聚電解質的潤濕液使用，延長有效潤滑時間。COF 達業界頂級（< 20g）。此為 Surmodics 的潤滑性能最佳化 IP，與 P29（光接枝）互補。

papers.title: Hydrophilic coating chemistry families: PVP vs PEG 定位 (PatSnap)
papers.purpose: PVP(潤滑) vs PEG(抗沾黏) 化學家族定位
papers.abstract_note: 本綜述分析親水塗層化學家族的技術定位與性能比較，重點探討 PEG 與 PVP 兩大主流系統。PEG 為研究最廣泛的抗沾黏材料，藉由空間排斥（steric repulsion）機制抑制蛋白質吸附；PVP 則藉由水合依賴性摩擦（hydration-dependent friction）提供優異潤滑性，是導管市場主流選擇。分析顯示 WCA < 20° 為親水性的基本門檻，而兩性離子材料（SBMA、MPC）在抗結痂性能上明顯優於傳統親水高分子。本報告為 本專案 選擇技術路線的核心依據。

full.bioteque_relevance: 清晰的技術路線圖：PVP→PEG→兩性離子，分階段降低風險提升性能

review.scope: 親水塗層化學家族比較分析（PatSnap 2026），涵蓋 PVP vs PEG vs 兩性離子的定位、性能、成本、法規

technologies_compared.verdict: 成熟/低成本/低法規風險，耐久性弱
生物相容佳，可調分子量，成本中等
抗結痂最強，成本高，IP風險中
仿生磷脂，血液相容最佳，成本最高
天然抗菌，耐久性弱，法規較複雜

consensus: 抗結痂能力：SBMA > MPC > PEG > PVP（順序已有共識）
潤滑性：SBMA ≈ MPC > PEGDA > PVP（高度交聯時差距縮小）
成本：PVP < PEG < chitosan < MPC < SBMA
法規風險：PVP < PEG < chitosan < MPC < SBMA
research_gaps: 各材料在尿液 pH 波動（5-8）下的長期穩定性缺乏頭對頭數據
混合配方（PVP+SBMA）的協同效果研究稀少
review.bioteque_strategic_value: 本專案 三階段技術路線圖的核心依據：Phase 1 PVP → Phase 2 PEGDA 交聯 → Phase 3 SBMA/MPC。此路線在成本/風險/性能三角上最優化。

full.summary: US8957125B2 is a later DSM coating formulation patent targeting faster/cleaner curing using substituted Norrish Type II photoinitiators. It uses a common PTGL1000(T-H)2 / PVP / Irgacure primer and a PVP K85 / PAcA hydrophilic topcoat in ethanol/water. Comparative A-C use Irgacure, benzophenone, or a simple combination and fail under 240 s cure; Examples I-V use substituted benzophenone-type photoinitiators and reach COF 0.03 with good feel at 240 s. At 180 s, IV and V remain best, especially V.

papers.title: WPU-stabilized hydrogel coating with lubrication and antibacterial on catheters
papers.authors: Zhang P; Gao Y; Li S et al.
papers.purpose: WPU+SBMA+NVP+chitosan UV固化多功能塗層
papers.abstract_note: 本研究以水性聚氨酯（WPU）作為底塗，再施用含季銨化幾丁聚醣（QCS）、磺基甜菜鹼甲基丙烯酸酯（SBMA）、N-乙烯吡咯烷酮（NVP）及硫酸鋅（ZnSO₄）的 UV 固化水凝膠頂塗，開發兼具潤滑與抗菌功能的雙效塗層。量化結果：界面結合強度 536 N/m，水接觸角 24.6°，摩擦係數（COF）0.0357，塗層厚度可藉配方調整。體外抗菌測試顯示對大腸桿菌（E. coli）有效抑制。塗層適用於 TPU 基材輸尿管支架，為多功能親水塗層的重要研究進展。
papers.value_to_project: UV固化+多功能塗層配方，直接適用本專案 UV製程；附著力536N/m是重要基準

full.summary: WPU 穩定化水凝膠塗層（期刊論文），以水性聚氨酯（WPU）為底塗，再施用含季銨化幾丁聚醣（QCS）+ SBMA + NVP + ZnSO₄ 的 UV 固化水凝膠頂塗，達到潤滑與抗菌雙效。COF 0.0357，WCA 24.6°，界面結合強度 536 N/m。ZnSO₄ 的引入對 E. coli 有效抑制。是目前文庫中最直接的「潤滑 + 抗菌」雙功能 UV 固化塗層論文。

papers.title: Lubricious coating (US7141246 / Cook Medical PVP+PU+isocyanate+抗菌)
papers.purpose: Cook Medical 親水塗層核心專利（PVP+PU interpolymer+抗菌釋放）
papers.abstract_note: 本發明揭示一種聚乙烯吡咯烷酮（PVP）與聚氨酯互穿聚合物（PU interpolymer）組成的親水塗層，以 isocyanate 交聯劑固化。配方中可加入抗菌添加劑（氯己定 chlorhexidine 或銀離子 silver）形成具緩釋抗菌功能的複合塗層。銀離子及氯己定在含水環境中以受控速率釋放，持續抑制導管表面細菌定植。本發明與 Hydromer 親水塗層技術相關，適用於需長期留置且具高感染風險的導尿管及輸尿管支架。
papers.value_to_project: Cook的PVP+isocyanate熱固化路線，與P06(Hydromer)同源。加入抗菌緩釋是差異化
papers.patent_notes: Cook Medical家族專利：US6645483(2003)→US7141246(2006)→US7402620(2008)。PVP+PU interpolymer+抗菌添加劑。熱固化路線

full.summary: Cook/Sherwood P30 (US7141246) is a platform patent for lubricious PVP + urethane / isocyanate coating vehicles. The full text contains four concrete examples: (1) a base PVP / ethyl lactate / toluene / isocyanate prepolymer vehicle; (2) PVC thoracic catheter dip coating with up to 60% friction reduction; (3) THF / Pellethane / PVP K-90 vehicle carrying tolnaftate and norfloxacin, where Pellethane controls antibiotic release and PVP controls lubricity; and (4) silver-salt / heparin vehicle for PVC medical devices with release regulated by Pellethane:PVP ratio and strong protein/platelet reduction signals.

可添加抗菌劑（chlorhexidine/silver）藥物緩釋

actionable_insights: For P30, do not summarize it only as PVP/PU/isocyanate: the important design knobs are Pellethane level for drug release, PVP level for lubricity, and silver particle/complex choice for adherence.
Example 2 is the cleanest device-level reference for heat-cured PVC catheter lubricity.
Example 3 and 4 are more valuable for antimicrobial-release design than Example 1.
UV/PDA/PEGDA or zwitterionic routes remain clearer design-around directions because P30 is a thermal urethane/isocyanate drug-carrier route.
red_flags: Toluene, THF, NMP, MDI/TDI and isocyanate chemistry create EHS and extractables concerns.
Antibiotic and silver release designs require dose-window and biocompatibility testing.
PVP above about 2.5% may hurt coating adherence and silver release in Example 4.
P30 and P31 are family-related; avoid counting P31 as an entirely separate technology leap.
full.vs_database: 與P06(Hydromer)同源的熱固化PVP-PU路線。差異化在抗菌添加劑。與P01(DSM UV雙層)完全不同世代。Cook走熱固化+抗菌，DSM走UV+polyelectrolyte
full.bioteque_relevance: P30 與 P31 需一併評估。UV 路線（Phase 2）是與 Cook 熱固化路線最清晰的設計迴避。Phase 3 抗菌設計需確認不落入 P30/P31 的 claim 範圍。
key_findings: Example 1 establishes the base PVP + ethyl lactate + toluene + isocyanate-terminated prepolymer coating vehicle.
Example 2 applies the coating to PVC thoracic catheters and reports wet lubricity plus up to 60% friction reduction.
Example 3 replaces toluene with THF for isocyanate-prepolymer solubility and adds tolnaftate/norfloxacin antimicrobial agents.
Example 3 states Pellethane level controls antibiotic release, while PVP level controls lubricity.
Example 4 adds silver salts and heparin; silver release is regulated by Pellethane:PVP ratio and particle size affects coating adherence/uniformity.
P30 is the platform bridge between the expired/precursor P34 route and the P31 antimicrobial sustained-release extension.

papers.title: Lubricious coating with antimicrobial release (US7402620 / Cook续案)
papers.purpose: Cook Medical塗層續案，強化抗菌添加劑配方
papers.abstract_note: 本發明為 US7141246 之續案，揭示 PVP 與 PU interpolymer 複合塗層的抗菌延伸應用，加入多種抗菌劑（氯己定 chlorhexidine、三氯生 triclosan、銀離子 silver）。發明強調抗菌劑在含水環境中以持續釋放（sustained release）機制作用，維持長達數週的抗菌效果。三氯生具廣譜抗菌活性，氯己定對 Gram-positive 菌種效果優異，銀離子對生物膜形成有顯著抑制作用。複合抗菌策略降低單一抗菌劑的耐藥風險。
papers.value_to_project: 抗菌塗層配方參考（Phase 3方向），Cook的抗菌+潤滑整合方案
papers.patent_notes: Cook家族第三代。新增抗菌緩釋和Vitamin E保存穩定性

full.summary: Cook Medical P31（US7402620）為 P30（US7141246）續案，在 PVP+PU interpolymer+isocyanate 熱固化潤滑塗層基礎上，新增 chlorhexidine（0.1-5%）、triclosan、silver 三種抗菌劑的可控緩釋設計，加入 Vitamin E 作抗氧化保存穩定劑。抗菌劑嵌入 PU 網絡以擴散機制緩慢釋放，維持數週抑菌濃度。熱固化製程免 UV 設備，可塗管腔內壁。對 本專案 而言是 Phase 3 抗菌設計的核心參考配方，但 triclosan 的 FDA 法規疑慮與 chlorhexidine 的生物相容性評估複雜度需注意。建議以 silver 作為優先抗菌劑，配合 UV 路線或 QCS 高分子抗菌以迴避 P31 核心 claim。

papers.authors: Diane McGhee / Sherwood Service AG; later Covidien / KPR
papers.purpose: Precursor to P30/P31 family logic: PVP + isocyanate-terminated prepolymer lubricious coating with antimicrobial / antithrombogenic carrier function.
papers.abstract_note: US6645483B2 discloses a lubricious hydrophilic coating for catheters, AV shunts, feeding tubes, endotracheal tubes and other medical devices. The composition includes PVP, polyoxyethylene-based isocyanate-terminated prepolymer, ethyl lactate and toluene, and can carry chlorhexidine, silver salts, antibiotics, heparin or other pharmacological additives. Google Patents links US7141246B2 as a priority-related application, so this is a precursor node for the P30/P31 path, but the assignee is Sherwood/Covidien/KPR, not Cook.
papers.value_to_project: Important expired precursor for the PVP/PU/isocyanate antimicrobial-release route; useful for mapping P30/P31 design history and FTO boundaries.
papers.patent_notes: Google Patents: priority 1998-10-07; filed 2000-12-18; granted 2003-11-11; status Expired - Lifetime; anticipated expiration 2018-10-07. Current assignee Covidien AG / KPR US LLC; original assignee Sherwood Service AG. US7141246B2 is listed as a priority-related application.

full.summary: US6645483B2 is an important precursor to the P30/P31 style PVP/PU/isocyanate antimicrobial lubricious coating path. It is not a Cook-owned patent; Google Patents identifies Sherwood Service AG as original assignee and Covidien/KPR as later assignees. The coating vehicle uses PVP plus a polyoxyethylene-based isocyanate-terminated prepolymer in ethyl lactate/toluene, with antimicrobial or antithrombogenic additives such as chlorhexidine, silver salts, antibiotics or heparin. It targets >50% friction reduction, broad substrate adhesion, wet abrasion resistance, and controlled release of pharmacological additives. The US patent is expired, making it useful as a baseline reference while later related patents still need FTO review.
key_findings: PVP + polyoxyethylene-based isocyanate-terminated prepolymer is the core lubricious/adhesion backbone
Can carry chlorhexidine, silver salts, antibiotics, heparin and other pharmacological additives
Targets wet lubricity, wide substrate adhesion and wet abrasion resistance
Uses ethyl lactate and toluene solvent system
US7141246B2 is priority-related, connecting this precursor to P30/P31
US case is expired

papers.abstract_note: 本發明揭示一種同時具備潤滑性與超音波可視性（echogenicity）的複合塗層結構，應用於活檢針、導管及 guidewire。PVP 系親水潤滑層提供低摩擦性能；塗層中嵌入含氣體的聚合物微球（echogenic microparticles），在超音波照射下強散射聲波，提升器械在超音波引導手術中的定位精度。兩種功能層分層設計，互不干擾。動物實驗驗證超音波可視度提升三倍以上，同時維持親水塗層的潤滑性能。

papers.title: Ureteral Stent Encrustation: Epidemiology, Pathophysiology, Management and Current Technology
papers.authors: Tomer N; Garden E; Small A; Palese M / Mount Sinai
papers.purpose: 輸尿管支架結痂機制+管理策略完整綜述
papers.abstract_note: 本綜述系統性回顧輸尿管支架結痂的流行病學、病理生理機制及預防策略。結痂機制涉及四個階段：尿液蛋白質沉積形成 conditioning film，隨後細菌（以 Proteus mirabilis 為主）定植形成 biofilm，細菌分解尿素使尿液鹼化，最終促進磷酸鈣及草酸鈣晶體快速沉積。風險因子包括留置時間、患者尿液成分及細菌定植情況。預防策略包括親水塗層、兩性離子塗層、藥物洗脫及定期更換。本綜述首次提出基於 conditioning film 阻斷策略的設計框架，為後續研究提供理論基礎。
papers.value_to_project: 理解結痂發生機制的基礎綜述。設計抗結痂塗層前必讀

papers.title: New Stent Technologies
papers.authors: Janssen P; Tailly T / Ghent University
papers.purpose: 輸尿管支架技術全景：設計、材料、塗層
papers.abstract_note: 本綜述全面回顧輸尿管支架的技術改進方向，涵蓋三個維度：支架結構設計（stent architecture）、生物材料選擇（biomaterials）及表面塗層技術（surface coatings）。針對主要副作用（泌尿道感染、結痂、疼痛及支架移位），本文系統性比較各類塗層材料的臨床表現。研究顯示 TPU 正逐漸取代傳統矽膠與 PVC 成為支架主流基材，原因在於 TPU 提供更好的柔韌性與塗層附著性。可生物降解支架為未來方向，但機械性能成熟度仍需提升。

papers.title: Application, Advancement, and Complication of Ureteral Stent and Encrustation: A Major Complication
papers.authors: Bhardwaj M; Ingole N / Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College
papers.purpose: 結痂的風險因子與管理策略綜述
papers.abstract_note: 本綜述從臨床角度回顧輸尿管支架的應用現況、技術進展及併發症管理，以三個技術維度為框架：材料科學、器械設計及表面塗層。研究確認留置時間（dwell time）是結痂最關鍵的風險因子，超過四週後結痂率急劇上升。高風險族群包括細菌尿症（bacteriuria）、尿石症（urolithiasis）、糖尿病（DM）、慢性腎病（CKD）及反覆泌尿道感染（recurrent UTI）患者。有效塗層可將安全置留期從四週延長至八至十二週，顯著降低患者複診頻率及醫療成本。

papers.title: New insights into the prevention of ureteral stents encrustation
papers.authors: Guo H; Yuan JB / Xiangya Hospital
papers.purpose: 結痂預防策略更新（2023最新）
papers.abstract_note: 本綜述深入分析輸尿管支架結痂預防的最新進展，以兩大結痂路徑為核心框架：conditioning film 形成路徑（蛋白質沉積驅動）及 biofilm 形成路徑（細菌驅動）。從泌尿結石形成的病理機制出發，本文比較三種預防策略的臨床效果：支架結構改良、生物材料替換及 bio-coating 表面功能化。SBMA 兩性離子塗層的四週結痂率降至 25%（對照組無塗層為 80%，PVP 塗層為 55%），被確認為目前臨床證據最強的抗結痂塗層方案。利尿劑與塗層協同使用可進一步降低結痂率。

papers.purpose: Coloplast Imajinhydro（hydrocoated silicone）vs Boston Scientific Percuflex Plus臨床比較
papers.abstract_note: 本研究為多中心隨機對照試驗（141 名患者），比較矽膠水化（hydrocoated）支架與 Percuflex 支架在三週留置期間的臨床表現。主要終點為支架表面 biofilm 量化評分：矽膠水化組 0.93 vs. Percuflex 組 1.24（p = 0.0021），差異具統計顯著性，顯示親水塗層可有效減少 biofilm 形成。次要終點包括患者症狀評分（疼痛、頻尿）及泌尿道感染發生率。本研究為目前已發表的輸尿管支架塗層比較試驗中樣本數最大者之一，為臨床選擇塗層支架提供直接依據。

papers.title: In vitro and in vivo study of antibacterial and anti-encrustation coating on ureteric stents (propolis EEP)
papers.authors: Zhao Y; Chen G; Yang L / Sichuan Univ
papers.purpose: 蜂膠（propolis）塗層在PU輸尿管支架的抗菌+抗結痂評估（in vivo大鼠Proteus mirabilis模型）
papers.abstract_note: 本研究評估 EEP（propolis 乙醇萃取物）塗層在輸尿管支架上的抗菌及抗結痂效果。體外實驗顯示 EEP 塗層對 biofilm 抑制率超過 90%，且抗菌效果可維持長達三個月。大鼠 in vivo 實驗證實 EEP 塗層組的細菌定植量、結石沉積量及鹽類沉積量均顯著低於對照組。Propolis 含有多種天然抗菌活性成分（如咖啡酸苯乙酯 CAPE），對多種泌尿道病原菌具廣譜抗菌活性。天然來源、低毒性及雙重抗菌/抗結痂功能使 EEP 塗層成為值得關注的新興輸尿管支架塗層材料。
papers.value_to_project: 天然抗菌塗層案例。但商業化難度高+標準化困難。可作為差異化研究方向參考

full.summary: 抗菌抗結痂功能性支架體外體內驗證：藥物/抗菌材料複合塗層，雙功能量化

papers.title: Heparin/poly-l-lysine-copper coating for surface functionalization of ureteral stent
papers.authors: Awonusi BO; Yang K; Zhao J / Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.purpose: Heparin/PLL/Cu奈米粒子塗層的in vivo大鼠評估（28天感染膀胱模型）
papers.abstract_note: 本研究開發由 heparin、poly-l-lysine（PLL）及銅奈米粒子（Cu NPs）組成的三層 LbL（layer-by-layer）自組裝塗層用於輸尿管支架。體外測試顯示塗層顯著減少細菌附著、urease 酵素活性及草酸鈣晶體沉積。大鼠 in vivo 實驗（28 天）確認 Cu NPs 持續緩釋（>2 週），宿主發炎反應（炎症標記物）顯著低於對照組。Heparin 提供抗凝血及抗蛋白質吸附功能；poly-l-lysine 作為帶正電層橋接 heparin 與基材；Cu²⁺ 離子提供持效抗菌活性。本研究為多功能複合塗層的代表性工作，惟 Cu²⁺ 劑量控制需進一步優化。
papers.value_to_project: 三合一複合塗層思路：抗凝（heparin）+陽離子殺菌（PLL）+金屬離子（Cu）。可作為Phase 3抗菌方向參考。開放全文

full.summary: Heparin/poly-L-lysine/copper三層塗層：抗凝+抗菌+抗結痂，Cu²⁺緩釋機制

papers.title: Lubricious coating (US20010051669A1 / Sherwood-Covidien P34 publication)
papers.purpose: P34 publication-stage node for lubricious coating vehicle with pharmacological additive release control.
papers.abstract_note: Google Patents describes a lubricant coating vehicle for medical devices that reduces coefficient of friction upon moisture exposure and allows pharmacological additive release rate control by salt form and urethane pre-polymer concentration.
papers.value_to_project: Do not count as a separate innovation from P34 unless claim comparison reveals meaningful differences; useful for tracing original disclosure language.
papers.patent_notes: Google Patents: filed 2000-12-18; published 2001-12-13; inventor Diane McGhee; status Granted.

inference_flags: * First-pass agent reading from Google Patents metadata/abstract. Claim-by-claim parsing still needed before FTO use.
full.summary: US20010051669A1 is the publication-stage disclosure that leads into the Sherwood/Covidien P34 lubricious coating family. Its abstract matches P34 closely: a moisture-activated lubricious coating vehicle for medical devices, capable of incorporating pharmacological additives with release controlled by additive salt form and urethane pre-polymer concentration.
key_findings: 全文包含 EXAMPLE 1-4，不只是摘要中的單一 lubricious coating vehicle。
Example 1 建立 PVP / ethyl lactate / toluene / isocyanate-prepolymer 基礎配方。
Example 2 給出 PVC thoracic catheter dip coating SOP，80°C 烘烤 60 分鐘，摩擦降低最高 60%。
Example 3 用 Pellethane / PVP K-90 / Tolnaftate / Norfloxacin 展示抗菌藥物釋放控制。
Example 4 用 silver salts / PVP / Pellethane / heparin 展示抗菌與抗血栓方向，並有蛋白吸附與血小板黏附數據。

claim_focus: Lubricious coating vehicle for medical devices.
Pharmacological additive release within acceptable pharmacokinetic criteria.
Release tuning by salt form and urethane pre-polymer concentration.
design_around_notes: Because this appears to be the P34 publication, compare claims with US6645483B2 before treating it as separate IP.
UV/PDA/SBMA or non-urethane-prepolymer routes remain natural design-around directions.

full.company_path_note: Cook/Sherwood/Covidien path support node: original publication language before P34 granted claims.
next_actions: Compare with P34 claim 1.
If claim scope is identical, mark as same-family duplicate and keep only for family tree.

papers.authors: Xin Qu; Tom Schottman; Rainer Gruening; Paul N. Chen; Joseph Conte; Zheng Wang / Hydromer Inc
papers.purpose: PCT/international family node for Hydromer P38 biopolymeric lubricious network branch.
papers.abstract_note: Google Patents describes network compositions with associated saccharide chains and monomers linked through ester, ether, amide, ketone, urea, carbamate, aluminum oxide or siloxane linkages, capable of adhering to a substrate.
papers.value_to_project: Useful for design ideas around biopolymer networks, but likely same branch as abandoned US20080114096A1.

full.summary: WO2008133646A1 is the PCT family member of Hydromer P38. The full text contains many chitosan / lactic acid / acrylic acid network-coating examples, with heparin, salicylic acid/aspirin, glutaraldehyde, semialdehyde, polyurethane, PVC, silicone, glass, guidewire and stent variants.
